issues.jp_before: 試験[しけん]{までに|madeni-deadline}、漢字[かんじ]{を|o-object}三百[さんびゃく]覚[おぼ]えたいです。
issues.problem: Bare number 三百 after 漢字を lacks the counter; 三百字 is the natural form.
issues.action: Changed 三百 to 三百字[さんびゃくじ].

issues.jp_before: 今月[こんげつ]{の|no-possessive}終[お]わり{までに|madeni-deadline}、部屋[へや]{を|o-object}探[さが]します。
issues.problem: 探す means 'look for', not 'find'; 'look for a room by the end of the month' is an odd deadline and mismatches the English 'find'.
issues.action: Rewrote as 新しいアパートを見つけたいです / 'I want to find a new apartment by the end of this month.'

issues.jp_before: 一年[いちねん]{の|no-possessive}終[お]わり{までに|madeni-deadline}、旅行[りょこう]{に|ni-purpose}行[い]きたいです。
issues.problem: 一年の終わり is unnatural for 'the end of the year' (this calendar year).
issues.action: Changed 一年[いちねん] to 今年[ことし].

issues.jp_before: 今日[きょう]{は|wa-topic}夜[よる]{まで|made-until}雨[あめ]{が|ga-subject}降[ふ]るでしょう。
issues.action: Changed English to 'It will probably rain until tonight.'
